posts.text:
We just learned of the tragic passing of David Wilcock. We are praying for his family and loved ones and the millions of lives he impacted. 

🕊️John 8:32
If there are no reforms to FISA and no Voter ID, it must be killed.

No Member of Congress who is convicted of sexual assault should continue to benefit from taxpayer-funded pensions. Regardless of party, this is basic accountability and something we should all agree on, which is why I am proud to co-lead this critical legislation alongside my colleague from across the aisle Rep. Suhas Subramanyam.
In light of 3 resignations in 2 weeks 1 thing is clear: Congress needs an ethics OVERHAUL. From me in @spectator.

Well done @RepGregSteube on ridding Congress of a Congresswoman who stole $5 million from the American people!


Congresswoman Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick (@CongresswomanSC)




Community note: Rep. Shelia Cherfilus-McCormick was investigated for carrying out a multimillion-dollar laundering scheme involving FEMA funds, rerouting much of the proceeds to fund her 2021 congressional campaign. Nearly all of the counts against her have been proven.

BYE BYE 👋🏻


Jake Sherman (@JakeSherman)

🚨@CongresswomanSC has resigned effective 1:30p today.

TY @RepGregSteube for leading the charge to expel corrupt Member of Congress Sheila McCormick!

Sheila McCormick has been found guilty on 25 counts yet she still refuses to resign, so she will now be EXPELLED. It shouldn’t take 3+ years to investigate corruption, House Ethics needs a COMPLETE overhaul.

Video

John, there will be NO FISA without voter ID. 
@LeaderJohnThune


Jordain Carney (@jordainc)

Thune leaving the door open to Senate going first on FISA 702 extension: 

"We'll see. That's a conversation that we're having. ...We're going to be looking for a path forward on that and we'll see what that looks like. I'll have a better sense of that probably later in the week"



— https://nitter.net/jordainc/status/2046313525577187398#m
Don’t tread on my turtles. Protected means protected. #EndangeredSpeciesAct
Just so America knows, after two weeks in recess, John Thune is no longer considering the SAVE America Act.

She will be expelled for corruption TOMORROW. Enjoy your last day in Congress Sheila!


Jamie Dupree (@jamiedupree)
